base: RC2 original recovery/fold flow; no D1-120 wait, no D2-C preopen or release-order change

change.semantic: particle inter-friction scaling in the PBD particle material
change.scope: episode start through initial dynamics, recovery, fold, release and retreat; not a release-only contact change
change.hypothesis: particle inter-friction may affect later global slip through layer contact, fold shape or the release state
change.if_unchanged: no sensitivity observed at this setting; this does not exclude other friction or contact mechanisms

preserved.action_targets: expert logic unchanged; may be recomputed if recovery observation changes

observation.per_stage: vertices, particle velocities (actual view readback when available), EE, joints, gripper, attachment
observation.release_t0: pre-release last attached state; first detached physics step is the boundary sample; no zero-step post-disable sample in the RC2 original flow
observation.sampling_error: report pre-release -> first detached step/time interval; do not claim an exact instant

expected_phenomenon: if particle inter-friction is effective, release-transient decay and/or steady slip speed may decrease
if unchanged, no sensitivity is observed at this setting; other friction/contact mechanisms remain possible
recovery/fold geometry or stickiness may change because the parameter is active from episode start
release first-step centroid speed in the D1/D2-C diagnostics is ~11 mm/s; this is a speed measurement, not an impulse measurement

comparison.pass: original geometry + centroid <=1 mm + vertex P95 <=3 mm + complete release/evidence
comparison.no_scan: one value, no parameter sweep; no seven-case rerun; no held-out; formal success count unchanged

notes: a5-rc2-pfs1 is derived from the RC2 original flow, not from D1-120 or D2-C.
Only particleFrictionScale changes from 0.0 to 1.0; friction remains 0.3.
The initial 4202 state file is reused with its existing hashes and is not regenerated.
This is a particle inter-friction sensitivity, not a claim that ground friction is fixed.
